title: Very long summary (3,100+ words) with disposition, follow-up, pending results and post-acute choice buried mid-document; urosepsis, home with home health; nursing list omits apixaban

rationale.disposition: EDGE (long document): the disposition section sits about halfway through a 3,100-word summary, after the problem-based course.
rationale.pending_results: EDGE (long document): buried mid-document; the final repeat blood culture report is pending and Dr. Strand-Okoye will follow it.
rationale.pac_list: EDGE (long document): the Medicare-certified home health agency list is documented in a mid-document paragraph.
rationale.pac_choice: Freedom to choose was explained and the patient chose Larchmont Home Health Partners.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Care Compare star ratings and patient survey ratings were reviewed with the patient and daughter.
rationale.discharge_meds: The discharge medication list appears near the end, after the lab tables and consultant recommendations; the earlier home-medications list is the pre-admission list, not the discharge list.
rationale.meds_consistent: PLANTED GAP: apixaban 5 mg twice daily is on the summary's discharge list but missing from the nursing medication list.
rationale.followup: Each follow-up has a named clinician and a date or interval.
